title: What is US Open prize money?
facts: The singles champions of the 2025 US Open will each receive $5 million (£3.74m) in prize money.
The US Open prize pool increased by 39% compared to 2024.
Jannik Sinner and Aryna Sabalenka each received $3.6 million for winning the singles titles in 2024.
Total prize money for the 2025 US Open reached $90 million (£67.3m).
Wimbledon awarded £53.5 million in total prize money in 2025.
The Australian Open awarded £47 million in total prize money in 2025.
The French Open awarded £49 million in total prize money in 2025.
Singles runners-up at the 2025 US Open receive £1.87 million in prize money.
Semi-finalists in the singles draw receive £943,000 in prize money.
Singles players eliminated in the first round receive £82,000 in prize money.
Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori won $1 million (£736,880) combined for winning the 2025 mixed doubles championship.
Errani and Vavassori defeated Casper Ruud and Iga Swiatek in the 2025 US Open mixed doubles final.
Men's and women's doubles champions receive close to £750,000 per pair.
A total of £1.2 million was allocated across the wheelchair competition at the 2025 US Open.
The 2025 US Open introduced a new stand-alone mixed doubles championship tournament.
